info.title: ambientCG files
info.description: The two Backblaze B2 hosts of the ambientCG-Web bucket: acg-download.struffelproductions.com (the zips a download redirects to) and acg-media.struffelproductions.com (the thumbnails previewImage names). Written from the api lane's answers and Backblaze's b2_download_file_by_name page (spec/SOURCE.md).

get.summary: Downloads one file using a bucket name and file name
get.description: To this base, you add file/, your bucket name, a /, and then the name of the file. The file name may itself include more / characters. The response contains the headers Content-Length, Content-Type, X-Bz-File-Name and X-Bz-Content-Sha1.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: The file name, which may itself include more / characters.

404.description: File with such name does not exist.
